jobs.description:
Job description 

Your job in a nutshell In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery. You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do? • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium • You check deliveries and documents • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like? • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed

What do we expect from you? • CE driving licence with certificates (Code 95 – medical fitness certificate) • Good knowledge of English is a must, Lithuanian is a plus • You are flexible and customer-oriented • You live in the Geel region • You perform physical work with a smile • Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

What do you get in return? • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home • Working with clear structure and fixed routes • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates • Flexible mindset • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian • Living in the Geel region

Job description 
 Our client specializes in solving logistical challenges that others cannot handle. Whether it’s a large machine part, a box of special screws, or medical equipment, their drivers ensure every delivery is handled carefully and delivered on time. 
For this position, we are looking for a driver with a strong sense of responsibility.
 What does the job involve? 
    
• Daily start times vary between 05:00 and 08:00, with your schedule sent by SMS the evening before
    
• Finishing times are flexible, as new assignments can come in throughout the day
    
• You will drive across the Benelux and occasionally beyond, delivering to hospitals, factories, and companies in cities such as Rotterdam, Amsterdam, and Brussels
    
• You transport one load per trip (dedicated transport): directly from point A to point B
    
• After a delivery in places like Düsseldorf, you may continue through Amsterdam and Antwerp before returning home
    
• Some days involve only national trips, usually shorter routes but following the same dedicated transport principle
    
• You will cover many kilometers while generally being home every weekend
    
• Most assignments are day trips, although overnight stays in the truck are possible by agreement
 Flexibility & work-life balance 
The dispatcher takes your private schedule into account whenever possible with timely communication, but flexibility remains essential for this role.
 Depot location 
Your truck starts and ends each day at the depot in Duffel, so having your own transport to reach the location is required.

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license + Code 95
    
• Strong sense of responsibility
    
• Independent working attitude
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English

Job description 

At this correct company with a family atmosphere, you will drive with clean and well-maintained equipment and primarily do large distribution of pallet goods in the Benelux, France, and Germany.

You will leave early and drive for quite a few hours, but you will still sleep in your own bed every night. You will receive your schedule via the onboard computer (Transics), so you can usually depart from home.

All hours are paid, and in case of any issues, you can always rely on the planning team that will support you. So, if you are a motivated driver with some experience who wants to earn a good income while being home every day, please contact us, and we will ensure you can start quickly!

 Requirements 

    
• License C/CE with the necessary certificates
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Physically fit, you load & unload yourself
    
• Experience as a driver and within the sector
    
• Independent, safety, and collegial are some of your keywords
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch/English

Job description 

Earn like an international driver while being home every day!

    
• Collection of waste and press containers with recycled paper
    
• Daily trips within Belgium to companies
    
• Flexible start times between 03:00 and 06:00
    
• Average of 12 working hours per day, with the possibility to work more if desired
    
• 2 to 5 trips per day
    
• Experience with hook lift systems and truck-trailer combinations is a plus, but can be learned on the job
    
• Work from Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays in consultation
    
• Hours above 38/week and Saturday hours paid at 150%
    
• Preferably living in the Antwerp, Turnhout, or Hoogstraten region
    
• Permanent contract after a successful interim period
    
• More working hours = higher salary

Interested? Apply now!

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license
    
• Valid Code 95
    
• Experience is required
    
• Flexible attitude
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English
    
• Departure from Merksem

Job description 

Due to expansion, several modern trucks are ready for new drivers to embark on international journeys!

Join our family-owned company where safety, reliability, and professionalism come first.

Your Role:

    
• 
        
Conduct international transport across the Benelux, Germany, and France.

    
    
• 
        
Handle specialized cargo, such as heated liquids.

    
    
• 
        
Work primarily Monday morning to Friday evening, with occasional rotational weekends.

    
    
• 
        
Opportunities for national day trips in some cases.

    

Requirements:

    
• 
        
ADR certification is mandatory.

    
    
• 
        
Previous driving experience.

    
    
• 
        
Strong sense of responsibility and reliability.

    

What We Offer:

    
• 
        
Full-time, 6-day schedule with all hours fairly compensated.

    
    
• 
        
Thorough training and supervision during the first 6 months.

    
    
• 
        
Permanent contract after a successful probationary period.

    
    
• 
        
Modern, well-equipped trucks and a supportive work environment.

    

Interested? Quick responses mean a quick start! If you have any questions about the position, don’t hesitate to contact us.

 Requirements 

We are looking for a motivated professional who meets the following requirements:

    
• Driver's License CE: You must possess a valid CE driver's license.
    
• ADR Tank: You have a valid ADR tank certificate.
    
• Experience: You have experience as an international CE driver.
    
• Accuracy and Safety-Conscious: You work accurately and have a strong focus on safety.
    
• Willingness to Work: You are willing to work two weeks per month.
    
• Language Skills: You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.

If this appeals to you, we warmly invite you to apply!

What will you do? 
 

To support a strategic memory technology program in our 300 mm semiconductor pilot line, imec is looking for a Process Engineer to join our Deposition and Diffusion Development Engineering Team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, optimizing, and sustaining advanced semiconductor processes used in next-generation memory devices. You will work at the intersection of process development, equipment engineering, manufacturing operations, and device integration, helping to drive innovative technologies from concept to implementation. Typical responsibilities include:
 
 

• Developing and optimizing deposition processes for advanced memory applications. 

• Managing process qualifications and equipment performance to ensure stable and reproducible manufacturing. 

• Coordinating critical lot movement and operational activities within the cleanroom. 

• Stabilizing and simplifying memory process flows to improve manufacturability and cycle time. 

• Evaluating and introducing new materials for future memory technology requirements. 

• Driving Statistical Process Control (SPC) implementation, monitoring, and documentation. 

• Supporting tool installation, qualification, and technology transfer activities. 

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams across process integration, device engineering, operations, and equipment engineering. 

• Daily follow-up of process & tool qualification, stability, improvements and problem prevention 

• Troubleshooting issues related to the processing and enables first and second line trouble shooters to step up 

• Investigating recurring issues, focusing on root cause analysis and structural solutions 

• Designing experimental plans and executes them in the cleanroom, performing data analysis and taking care of reporting and documentation. 

• Depending on project requirements, your scope may be extended to include Dry Etch, Clean, CMP, and related process modules. 

• Working in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts 

• You are willing to work in a shift regime (early/late) and 1 weekend out of 4, in order to support the continuous FAB production.  

In summary, a very diverse and interesting role with significant responsibilities that allow you to gain a lot of expertise and build a large internal and external network.

Who are you?
 

We welcome applications both from experienced engineers as well as fresh graduates. Please include a motivation letter in your application. Minimum requirements:
 
 

• You obtained a master’s in science or in Engineering or equal to this, and you display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• 3 years industrial or advanced research experience in semiconductor process mainly in the deposition area. 

• Additional knowledge of memory process integration, Dry and wet etch/clean, CMP and metrology is considered a plus. 

• You can rapidly adapt to changes in circumstances by being able to change priorities at very short notice 

• A process & quality driven problem solver: you manage multiple priorities in a flexible manner in a continuously changing environment with a proactive “can do” attitude 

• You take ownership and you enjoy completing your tasks autonomously 

• Knowledge and experience of various process control and improvement techniques (e.g., SPC, Cp/CpK, FMEA, 8D, 6sigma, etc.). 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required 

• You are a flexible team player, and you enjoy working in environments where experiences and knowledge are shared with colleagues 

• Given the international character of imec, written and verbal fluency in English is a must  

Additional requirements considered as an asset:
 
 

• Any knowledge in advanced software packages (Python, Matlab, JMP, Minitab, Klarity, E3/FDC, etc.)

jobs.occupation: Category CE Driver – variable work, night shift
jobs.description:
Job description 

Transport of mainly sea containers in and around the port of Antwerp or Rotterdam during the night shift.

Occasionally also trailer exchange work with tarpaulin (Bache) to destinations such as Leuven or Liège.

Night work, usually shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals.

Approximately 12 hours per day.

Start between 5 PM and 6 PM, working days between 10 and 15 hours depending on workload and planning.

Good salary, departing from the right bank.

Permanent job with long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Driving licence CE + C95

    
• Dutch or English speaking
    
• Night work

About the Role

Are you a hands-on technical professional who enjoys troubleshooting industrial equipment as much as carrying out practical maintenance and repair work?

For an industrial production site in Louvain-la-Neuve, we are looking for an Electromechanic & Technical Handyman to join the team.

This is a varied role combining 50% industrial electromechanical maintenance and 50% general technical maintenance. You will play an important role in ensuring the reliability of the production line while keeping the company's facilities and infrastructure in good condition.

Your Responsibilities

50% – Electromechanical Maintenance

Monitor the production line and identify technical faults or malfunctions.

Diagnose electrical and mechanical problems and determine their root causes.

Carry out repairs and implement effective technical solutions to minimize production downtime.

Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on production equipment.

Check the proper functioning of machines and production installations.

Inspect electrical wiring and cabling and carry out troubleshooting when necessary.

Identify potential technical improvements to increase equipment reliability and performance.

Follow all applicable safety, quality and hygiene procedures.

50% – Technical Handyman & Facility Maintenance

Carry out general maintenance and repair work throughout the company.

Perform painting, minor renovation and finishing work.

Repair and maintain gates, doors and other company infrastructure.

Handle minor electrical, mechanical and technical repairs within your area of competence.

Identify maintenance needs and take the necessary corrective actions.

Ensure that buildings, facilities and work areas remain safe, functional and well maintained.

Support the team with various practical maintenance tasks as required.

We are looking for a versatile, hands-on professional with a strong technical background and a proactive approach.

You ideally have:

Previous experience in industrial maintenance.

Good knowledge of industrial electricity and mechanics.

Strong knowledge of electrical wiring and cabling.

The ability to diagnose faults, identify their causes and find practical solutions.

Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics or automation is an advantage.

Experience in the food, pharmaceutical or chemical industry is a strong asset.

Practical skills in general maintenance, repairs and basic building work.

A good understanding of safety procedures and technical instructions.

A structured, methodical and independent approach to your work.

A strong sense of responsibility, flexibility and problem-solving skills.

 

Languages

English: Very good proficiency.

French: Very good proficiency.

You must be comfortable communicating in both languages in a professional working environment.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday.

Flexible working schedule between 06:00 and 22:00, depending on the company's operational needs.

Availability to work within this time window is required.

jobs.occupation: Product Specialist Fiber Lasers & Press Brakes - Europe
jobs.description:
European HQ Brussels | Fiber Laser & Press Brake Expertise | Technical & Commercial Support | International En
Join the European headquarters of an international CNC machine tool manufacturer as a Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake in Brussels. In this permanent role, you will combine technical product expertise with commercial support, helping dealers, sales teams and customers across Europe find the right fiber laser and press brake solutions.
 You will work in an international environment and travel approximately one week per month across Europe for customer and dealer visits, machine demonstrations and trade fairs.

 Job at a glance

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Contract: Permanent
• Working hours: Full-time, 38 or 40 hours per week
• Salary: Up to approximately €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience
• Travel: Approximately one week per month within Europe
• Languages: Fluent Dutch and English
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field
• Benefits: Electric company car, charging or fuel card, insurance, pension plan and €10 meal vouchers
• Working hours: Flexible
About the organisation

This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centers, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
To further strengthen its fiber laser and press brake activities in Europe, the company is looking for a Product Specialist who combines technical expertise with strong commercial awareness.
 You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy and short communication lines.

 

 
Your new role
As Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake, you will be the European point of reference for fiber laser and press brake solutions.

You will support dealers, sales teams and end customers throughout the commercial and technical process, from pre-sales and machine configuration to demonstrations, training, product launches and technical support.

What will you do?

• Provide technical support for product- and application-related questions.
• Advise customers, dealers and sales teams on applications and suitable machine configurations.
• Analyse and resolve product-related technical challenges.
• Support dealers and sales teams throughout commercial sales processes.
• Develop clear product positioning and technical sales arguments.
• Deliver product and application training to dealers and sales teams.
• Demonstrate fiber laser and press brake machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support new product launches across the European market.
• Gather customer, dealer and market feedback and identify potential business opportunities.
• Collaborate with Sales, Service, Marketing and Product Management.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.The position covers the European market, with approximately one week of international travel per month.
 
 
What do you need? Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field.
• Experience in a technical, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to translate technical challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects and working with internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• A proactive and results-oriented mindset.
• Fluent Dutch and English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.Your strengths
 You are eager to learn and motivated to develop in-depth knowledge of fiber laser, press brake and CNC machine technologies. You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and commercial thinking, and you are comfortable working with colleagues and stakeholders across different European markets.

jobs.occupation: Flexi Kitchen Assistant - Antwerp City Center
jobs.description:
Looking for a flexible kitchen job that fits 
your schedule?
 

Do you enjoy working with food, being part of a team and seeing guests enjoy dishes you've helped create? Whether you're already an experienced kitchen professional or taking your first steps into hospitality, we'd love to meet you.
 

For our busy restaurant in the heart of 
Antwerp city centre, we're looking for a 
Flexi Kitchen Assistant who can strengthen our kitchen team based on their own availability.
 

The best part? 
You decide how you work. Prefer fixed days every week? Great. Rather work different shifts depending on your schedule? That's perfectly fine too.
 

What will you be doing?
 

As part of our kitchen team, you'll help bring every dish to life:
 
 

• Assisting with the preparation of ingredients and dishes 

• Grilling and preparing meat and fish 

• Helping with the finishing and plating of dishes 

• Ensuring every plate looks as good as it tastes 

• Supporting your colleagues during service 

• Maintaining cleanliness and hygiene standards throughout the kitchen  

Our goal is simple: every plate leaves the kitchen looking irresistible and comes back completely empty.

Who are we looking for?
 
 

• You're motivated and eager to learn 

• You enjoy working as part of a team 

• You can stay focused, even during busy services 

• You have a good command of English 

• Additional languages are always a plus 

• Experience is welcome, but certainly not required  

Whether you've spent years behind the stove or can barely tell a whisk from a spatula, we'll provide the training you need to succeed.

Join our Global Support Network (Gsn) and help ensure the reliability and availability of our healthcare IT solutions used by customers around the world.

As a Senior Support Engineer / Domain Expert, you will solve complex technical problems in business-critical customer environments, working closely with regional support teams, Cloud Operations, Professional Services, Product Management, Quality, and R&D. You will combine deep technical troubleshooting with strong customer engagement and take ownership of issues through resolution.

Beyond resolving incidents, you will help us prevent them by identifying recurring problems, improving our monitoring and observability capabilities, sharing knowledge, and contributing to more proactive and predictive support.

What you'll do

 
• Solve complex technical problems:
  
   
• Diagnose and resolve complex incidents affecting enterprise healthcare IT solutions.
   
• Take end-to-end ownership of technical issues and drive them toward resolution.
   
• Analyze logs, metrics, diagnostics, and system behavior to identify root causes.
   
• Coordinate technical activities across teams during critical customer situations.
   
• Communicate findings, recommendations, and resolution plans clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
  
 
• Be a technical expert:
  
   
• Build and maintain deep expertise in our products, technologies, and solution architectures.
   
• Provide advanced technical guidance to support teams around the world.
   
• Work across enterprise applications, operating systems, databases, networking, integrations, cloud, and containerized environments.
   
• Collaborate with R&D and other specialists on challenging technical issues and escalations.
  
 
• Prevent tomorrow's incidents:
  
   
• Identify recurring issues, technical trends, and systemic problems and contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions.
   
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our monitoring and observability platform, helping us identify emerging issues proactively, prevent incidents, and improve the reliability of our customers' environments.
   
• Turn lessons learned into technical documentation and reusable knowledge.
   
• Contribute ideas that improve product quality, support processes, automation, and operational efficiency.
  
 
• Help the team and our services grow:
  
   
• Share knowledge and mentor colleagues across our global support organization.
   
• Contribute to the operational readiness of new releases, upgrades, and customer deployments.
   
• Represent customer needs and operational experience when collaborating with Product Management, R&D, Quality, and other stakeholders.
   
• Explore opportunities to use automation and AI-assisted diagnostics to improve customer outcomes.
  

What will help you succeed

You enjoy solving difficult technical problems and are comfortable when the answer is not immediately obvious. You combine technical curiosity with a strong customer focus and

 
• Take ownership and follow problems through to resolution
 
• Communicate complex technical topics clearly
 
• Remain effective in high-pressure customer situations
 
• Collaborate well across teams, cultures, and geographies
 
• Enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others succeed
 
• Bring a continuous learning and improvement mindset

Fluent written and spoken English is required; additional languages are an advantage. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or a related discipline is preferred, although equivalent professional experience...

We are looking for someone with:

• 3 to 5 years of experience in technical customer support, enterprise software support, healthcare IT, or a comparable technical role.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, ideally gained in business-critical or mission-critical environments.

• A good understanding of enterprise application architectures, networking, operating systems, databases, and system integrations.

• Hands-on Kubernetes experience, including supporting and troubleshooting containerized applications and environments.

• Hands-on AWS experience, with practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, monitoring, and operations.

• Experience analyzing logs, metrics, diagnostics, and other technical data to isolate complex problems.

• Experience working directly with customers and managing technical escalations.

• Familiarity with ITSM and ITIL-based support processes.

• Experience with healthcare IT is an advantage, but not essential.

jobs.occupation: HR Assistant & Talent Acquisition - Luxury Fashion - Brussels
jobs.description:
As Talent Acquisition & HR Assistant, you will support recruitment activities across the Benelux region, managing candidate screening, interview coordination and HR administration. You will also contribute to key HR projects, while providing hands-on support to the HR team.
 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is an internationally renowned company active in the luxury retail and fashion sector. To support a period of ongoing HR Projects, they are looking for a Talent Acquisition & HR Assistant to reinforce their HR team on a temporary basis for an initial period of 3 to 4 months.

Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic, people-oriented, and collaborative working environment where teamwork, proximity, and flexibility are highly valued.

 

Omschrijving

As Talent Acquisition & HR Assistant, your responsibilities will include:

• Managing first stage of the recruitment process (sourcing and prescreening).
• Conducting interviews when required and supporting managers in the assessment process.
• Providing administrative support related to recruitment and HR activities.
• Assisting with employee documentation and personnel administration.
• Supporting the HR team during the implementation of Workday and related HR processes.
• Contributing to various HR projects depending on business needs and workload, including CSR initiatives, process improvements and administrative projects.
• Supporting payroll and HR operations where required.
 

• You hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
• You have minimum 2 years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition and/or HR administration.
• Previous exposure to Workday is a plus.
• You are fluent in French and English. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus.
• You are organised, proactive and hands-on.
• You enjoy working in a collaborative environment and easily build relationships with different stakeholders.
• You have strong administrative skills and are able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• You are approachable, team-oriented and thrive in a friendly and informal company culture.

jobs.occupation: Senior Technical Project Manager – Asset Management & NIS2
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Drive the roadmap and governance for IT, OT, and IoT asset management in collaboration with technical stakeholders.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams across infrastructure, cybersecurity, and platform management to improve data quality.
• Supervise the enhancement of CMDB data quality and the formalization of asset ownership responsibilities.
• Identify visibility gaps within the asset landscape and implement effective remediation actions.
• Oversee the integration of discovery and inventory sources into the ServiceNow platform.
• Ensure all asset management activities align with NIS2 requirements and internal cybersecurity policies.
• Prepare and lead project committees while providing detailed progress reporting and governance recommendations.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in technical project management.
• 5+ years of experience with PRINCE2 and Agile methodologies.
• 3+ years of experience with ServiceNow, specifically within HAM and SAM modules.
• 3+ years of experience in Risk Management and ISO 27001 compliance.
• You possess experience in OT and IoT asset management and governance.
• You bring expertise in CMDB modeling and the integration of authentic asset discovery sources.
• You have experience defining asset taxonomy, mandatory attributes, and governance rules.
• You're able to model relationships between assets, applications, and business services.
• You are fluent in English with a native level of French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of ISO 27001:2022 revisions.
• Experience working within public procurement regulations.

Responsibilities

• Deliver functional and technical support to business users on the LabWare platform.
• Create and manage incident tickets using ServiceNow to ensure timely resolution.
• Perform root cause analysis on production incidents to identify and mitigate underlying issues.
• Handle master data resolution and ensure functional alignment between SAP and LabWare.
• Translate technical challenges within digital methods into actionable insights for the system administrators.
• Monitor system errors proactively to identify trends and prevent recurring incidents.

Requirements

• You have 1+ years of experience in application support, specifically focused on LIMS or laboratory digital tools.
• You possess professional experience working with LabWare.
• You bring strong analytical capabilities to diagnose and resolve complex technical problems.
• You're customer-oriented with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical users and remain calm under pressure.
• You are fluent in French with a professional working knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Prior experience working within a GMP regulated environment.
• Functional knowledge of ServiceNow for incident management.

PROJECT

You work within the multi-national research environment of the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the Royal Military Academy. As a university, we conduct research in various technological domains, including unmanned systems, land mobility, and landmines manipulations, aimed at enhancing user comfort. Our work balances the development of novel and beneficial applications with efforts to mitigate potential risks associated with these technologies. As a military research lab, we focus on applications in public security and Defense. Examples of practical applications include ground robots for detecting and neutralizing landmines, unmanned vehicles for patrolling tough complex conditions, and studies to improve vehicle and environmental conditions.

 

In this position, you will work alongside a large team of research engineers, each leading their own projects. Your role will be to assist in the implementation of various projects, by contributing to the related electro-mechanical aspects. Given our strong involvement in European-scale collaborative projects, you will punctually prepare and follow on-site test campaigns, mainly on military test sites in Flanders, sometimes abroad.

 

WHAT WE OFFER within the projects

• Highly varied job content, giving you the opportunity to work on a very wide range of novel electro-mechanical systems (air, ground, maritime) in a very international context. You will be deployed in a large variety of projects and will be required to work together with dozens of researchers and other technicians to reach objectives. To make this a bit more specific, you will be deployed as an example in these projects:
• TiPODS: To support the construction (steelwork, electronics, automation), commissioning, maintenance, and usage of a test facility for land vehicle tires testing.
• AURORA: To support the development of a new generation of demining robots with dual manipulators
• STRATUS: To develop novel drones that are composed maximally of EU-sourced & developed components
• Opportunity to work in and with an international & dynamic team of research engineers.
• The flexibility and freedom to innovate and bring your own ideas.
• The ability to have an impact and work on societally relevant topics. As an example: many of our research projects are currently seeking solutions for mine clearance in Ukraine.
• An employer that strives towards maintaining a good work-life balance for its employees.
• Training opportunities to get new practical skills and/or improve your current skills (potential example: machinery certifications, heavy trailer driving license, A2-pilot flying license).
• Possibility of travelling for field trials with partners.
MAIN TASKS

• Manufacture mechanical components for scientific research (machining, welding, etc.).
• Utilize specialized instruments (sensor installation, cameras, measurement devices, etc.).
• Conduct mechanical and electrical tests on test benches, ensuring compliance with international standards.
• Calibrate and test laboratory equipment for specific experiments.
• Actively contribute to all project phases, including metalwork, electrical/electronical work, technical drawing, and system assembly.
• Participate in test campaigns (including equipment preparation, maintenance, execution, and problem solving).
• Assist in procurement and maintenance of equipment (including repairs and calibration of instruments). 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

The applicant shall have a professional bachelor's degree in electromechanics (a level 6 qualification according to the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) or similar) and should have relevant experience in the field of electronics, metalwork, and mechatronics.

Explicitly, we are not looking for an academic profile but a technical professional profile!

 

This position is ideally open for experienced profiles (minimum 3 years of experience).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Proven experience with electro-mechanical systems and troubleshooting
• Knowledge of security measures to perform work related to electricity (certifiable BA4/BA5 or similar)
• Demonstrated ability to think outside the box and devise innovative solutions to technical challenges in the field (a "MacGyver" mindset). In other words, a problem solver
• Driving license B (or in the process of getting it).
 

¿RECOMMENDED¿ skills:

• Proven workshop experience and skills (ex: welding, electrical design, mechanical design, CNC, etc.)
• Proven experience with robotic systems and troubleshooting
• Training or experience in system integration
• Experience with electrical measurement devices
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:

• Experience in programming with Labview/ROS/Matlab/C++/Python
• Proficiency in 3D printing technologies and design software (CAD) for rapid prototyping and repairs
• Knowledge of PCB design and soldering
• Drone Pilot License can be an advantage and/or experience with flying drones
 

Personal skills:

• You are highly motivated (read proactive) to develop technical/workshop skills that are not yet mastered.
• You have a practical mindset, showcasing a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
• You take initiative, you are involved and result oriented.
• You are honest, loyal toward the institution and respect confidentiality.
• You improve the team-spirit and solve interpersonal conflicts. 
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have very good knowledge of French or Dutch (oral & written) and a minimum knowledge of (or be willing to learn) the other language (oral), since lots of campaigns will be performed in Belgium. This will be tested during selection.
• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral & written), which will be tested during selection.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher is likely to be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defense.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European Defence Fund projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: 15 January  2027, in consultation with the applicant.
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours / week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• To be very clear: your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to a project that ends in Spring 2030. The financing of your contract beyond that period is therefore not 100% guaranteed. However, the RMA-MECA dept has a policy to keep the good elements and this position will in any case be required beyond that date as well, so if we're happy with you there is a high chance that we will offer you a follow-up beyond that date if you decide to stay.
• Wage scale: NBI1. RMA-Patrimony applies a merit-based research career track, allowing personnel to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations. Your bruto and netto salary can be simulated precisely via this tool: simulateur de salaire.
• Holiday pay.
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a BOSA test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€/day);
• Digital allowance: 15€/month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days/week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years)
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

jobs.occupation: Security Manager for Construction Projects at NATO HQ  M/W/X
jobs.description:
NATO's Office of Security is hiring!

The construction security expert will be responsible for ensuring the physical security of construction sites and building works at NATO Headquarters in Brussels. 

What you will be doing: 

• Coordinating security requirements for construction projects and contractor activity.
• Managing contractor and subcontractor authorisations, access permissions and security procedures.
• Working with NATO security teams, project managers and external companies.
• Inspecting compliance, identifying security risks, preparing reports and documentation.
Curious to know more? Click here to read the full job description.  
 
What we're looking for: 

• A university degree in security management, project/programme management, engineering, construction management, facilities management, risk management, or other relevant field.
• A minimum of 3 years' experience in roles requiring good knowledge of physical security systems, project coordination and stakeholder management. 
• Very good knowledge of English and/or French. 
 
 
What we offer: 

• A unique international experience, doing meaningful work in support of the most successful political-military alliance in history
• An initial three-year contract
• Competitive monthly tax-free salary 
• Excellent health insurance
• Annual leave of 30 days plus official NATO holidays
• Additional benefits for expatriate staff may include expatriation and education allowances (where applicable) and additional home leave.
For more details on working conditions and benefits, please visit the What do we offer? page on the NATO website.

We are seeking a Commis Chef to join our dynamic kitchen team at an exciting new Indian restaurant in Brussels. Key Responsibilities

• Assist in the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes, including curries, tandoor specialties, and starters.
• Support the Chef and kitchen team in daily operations.
• Ensure food quality, taste, and presentation meet restaurant standards.
• Handle tandoor equipment with proficiency, preparing items such as naan, kebabs, and grilled dishes.
• Perform kitchen tasks such as chopping, marinating, and pre-cooking ingredients. 
• Maintain cleanliness and hygiene standards in the kitchen, following HACCP protocols.
• Monitor and organize inventory of ingredients and supplies. 
• Prior experience (1-3 years) in an Indian kitchen, with a focus on tandoor cooking.
• Basic knowledge of Indian culinary techniques and ingredients.
• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong teamwork skills and a willingness to learn and grow.
• Good understanding of hygiene and safety standards in the kitchen.
• Basic communication skills in English. What We Offer 
• An opportunity to grow your culinary career in a supportive and inspiring environment.
• Hands-on experience in a modern Indian kitchen with room for skill development.
• The chance to be part of an exciting new restaurant venture.

Our client is looking for a Customer Care Project & SRS Coordinator who will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of customer projects from quotation through delivery. Acting as the link between multiple internal stakeholders, this person will help drive operational excellence while ensuring an outstanding customer experience.
 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

 
Our client is a globally recognised industrial manufacturer with a long-standing history of innovation and excellence. Serving customers across a wide range of sectors worldwide, the company is known for its high-quality engineered solutions, strong customer focus and commitment to continuous improvement.The organisation combines the stability of an international group with a collaborative and people-oriented culture. Employees are encouraged to grow professionally while working in a dynamic and multicultural environment.
 

Omschrijving

 

• Coordinate projects in collaboration with Customer Care, Project Coordination and Engineering teams.
• Act as a key point of contact between internal departments to ensure seamless project execution.
• Manage quotation and order-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.
• Monitor material availability and proactively expedite orders when required.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain teams to guarantee timely delivery of products.
• Ensure excellent customer service by adhering to established processes and best practices.
• Support customers by analysing requests, questions and operational challenges.
• Assist in customer care improvement initiatives and training-related projects.
• Contribute to operational projects and provide support to management when needed.
 

 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in customer service, project coordination or operations.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Experience working with ERP systems is considered an advantage.
• Customer-focused with excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable working cross-functionally in an international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a strong asset.
• Flexible mindset and willingness to occasionally travel.
